Method.subtitle: Metabolic Synchronization
Method.definition: An innovative, proven methodology designed to stimulate the endocrine system and reactivate and recalibrate metaboliSM for increased energy, vitality, and endurance, as well as faster recovery (balancing hormones and releasing neurotranSMitters).

biography.title: Founder's Biography
biography.name: Flédéric Payet
biography.p1: Over the past two decades, I have met countless individuals in distress across various regions of the world. I have faced their diverse health issues, just as I have coached athletes.
biography.p2: Ever since, I have constantly developed new methods to adapt to each individual. The gym has become a kind of preventive and curative hospital.
biography.p3: Through my research and experimentation, I came to understand the principles of metabolic synchronization and the natural stimulation of the endocrine system. The results across all types of profiles have been extremely conclusive, whether for athletes, individuals suffering from various pathologies, or amateurs.

analogy.title: The Bicycle Analogy
analogy.intro: Imagine your body is a bicycle, and for it to function properly, it requires regular maintenance. You need to oil the chain, tighten the brakes, change the tires, retighten the bolts, and ensure the suspension is in good condition.
analogy.why: Why this analogy? Because it brings me back to the body's metabolic functioning.
analogy.cogs: The SMall and large cogs represent heart rate or pulse.
analogy.conclusion: This means I modulate the effort so that the body reaches a state of ease—what I call metabolic effort—because it delivers an instant renewal of energy rather than exhaustion.

definition_section.title: What is Metabolic Synchronization?
definition_section.p1: It is a unique protocol designed to naturally stimulate the endocrine system, triggering the release of neurotranSMitters. Consequently, energy, endurance, and vitality levels increase significantly, enabling full and faster recovery from fatigue—whether caused by health issues or intensive sports training. This method can be universally and successfully followed by people of any age or physical condition.
definition_section.p2: The core innovation of this program is triggering a natural release of dopamine, endorphin, serotonin, etc. This self-stimulation of the endocrine system has a direct and positive impact on the health of patients or athletes and on their ability to eliminate fatigue. This represents a major breakthrough in physical training as it applies to:

targets.health_title: People with minor to major health issues
targets.health_desc: This program has been successfully followed by individuals suffering from severe chronic fatigue, fibromyalgia, migraines, heart problems, hypertension, burnout, depression, etc.
targets.athletes_desc: Athletes can boost their performance and accelerate recovery time before, during, and after workouts or competitions without using supplements (legal or illegal). This unique program complements their usual training routines, allowing faster and more complete recovery, thereby enhancing overall performance and reducing injury risk. Metabolic synchronization has assisted professional athletes in auto racing, tennis, football/soccer, etc.
targets.special_forces_desc: This methodology can also benefit professionals exposed to extreme physical conditions, such as Police Special Forces, the Military, Firefighters, etc. It has been adopted individually by several members of various entities, significantly improving their operational or training performance.

Method.disclaimer_title: What Metabolic Synchronization does not do
Method.disclaimer_body: The method was designed to naturally stimulate the endocrine system, yielding positive effects on health and performance. It serves as a complement to, and not a replacement for, traditional medical care.
Method.effort_desc: My method combines protocols in which I guide cardiovascular frequencies and heart rates during exertion to achieve the optimization of nervous and cognitive functions, and to maintain or restore body integrity—aiming to ensure its defense, trigger injury repair, and stimulate energy expenditure with a marked improvement in body composition. Sessions are tailored according to each person's level, goals, and constraints: progressive intensity management paired with active recovery.
Method.equipment_desc: Bikes, treadmills, ellipticals, stair climbers, weight machines, guided weight equipment. I integrate these tools to vary stimulation and maximize the efficiency of metabolic effort.
Method.eligibility_desc: All profiles from ages 14 to 99, with or without disabilities.
Method.ip_notice: N.B. For confidentiality reasons, exact protocols remain protected under intellectual property.
